svg.title: The order of checks that makes an evaluation reproducible
svg.desc: Six stacked rungs climb from local row checks, through set equality on the registry, paired seeds and nesting, digests and checkpoint provenance, deterministic ordering, up to the privacy allowlist and atomic publication.

g.text: Climb the ladder from local fields to published bytes
1. Check row fields, dtypes, and policy names
2. Compare the registry with the exact 28-row set
3. Verify paired seeds, shared manifests, and nesting
4. Verify manifest, phase-catalog, and checkpoint digests
5. Sort rows by an exact key, then compute
6. Pass the privacy allowlist, then publish atomically
Each rung assumes every rung below it has already passed.
